description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends a base 'FilterParams' class and provides properties and methods for encapsulating search filter parameters related to employee emergency contacts, specifically employee number and contact name. It also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for defining search filter parameters for employee emergency contacts in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee number and contact name, with methods to get and set these properties. It also defines allowed sorting fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'eec.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the search filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the search filter.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name filter value for the emergency contact.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name filter value for the emergency contact.
